repos_data.description: Met Museum MCP integration to discover the art collection at The Metropolitan Museum of Art in New York

One MCP search across open-access museum collections (The Met, Rijksmuseum, Smithsonian, Cleveland, AIC, SMK, Walters, Wellcome, Wikimedia Commons, Europeana, and growing) with strict per-museum rights verification and ready-to-use citations.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides AI assistants with access to the Smithsonian Institution's Open Access collections.

A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server providing access to Dutch parliamentary data (Tweede Kamer) through OpenTK . This server enables AI assistants to search, retrieve, and analyze parliamentary documents, activities, and information as published by parliament..
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides detailed type information from .NET projects for AI coding agents.
This is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that provides professional cycling data from FirstCycling. It allows you to retrieve information about professional cyclists, race results, and more.
Model Context Protocol server for travel.art — art-tourism data (biennales, art fairs, museum visitor guides) exposed to AI agents over MCP. Live at https://mcp.travel.art/
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementation for Autodesk Maya

BGG MCP provides access to BoardGameGeek and a variety of board game related data through the Model Context Protocol. Enabling retrieval and filtering of board game data, user collections, and profiles.

A Model Context Protocol server that provides network asset information based on query conditions. This server allows LLMs to obtain network asset information and supports querying network asset information by zoomeye dork etc.
A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Internet Archive's Open Library API that enables AI assistants to search for book and author information.
